plans.name: stockSql
plans.sql:
SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.pkg_units, s.unit_basis, s.ndc_match,
       p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route, p.strength, p.unit_content, p.pkg_unit
FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11
WHERE (lower(trim(coalesce(p.generic_name, ''))) RLIKE '^(?:(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free)[^a-z0-9-]+)*carboplatin(?:-[a-z]{4})?(?:[^a-z0-9-]+(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free))*(?:$|[,/;(].*|[^a-z0-9-]+(?:[0-9.].*|(?:and|in|with|w|injection|inj|tablet|tablets|tab|tabs|capsule|capsules|cap|caps|vial|vials|solution|soln|oral|for|usp|mdv|sdv|pf|premix|premixed|er|xr|sr|dr|odt|ivpb|bag|syringe|syr|lock|flush)(?:[^a-z].*)?$))' OR (p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(trim(coalesce(s.description, ''))) RLIKE '^(?:(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free)[^a-z0-9-]+)*carboplatin(?:-[a-z]{4})?(?:[^a-z0-9-]+(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free))*(?:$|[,/;(].*|[^a-z0-9-]+(?:[0-9.].*|(?:and|in|with|w|injection|inj|tablet|tablets|tab|tabs|capsule|capsules|cap|caps|vial|vials|solution|soln|oral|for|usp|mdv|sdv|pf|premix|premixed|er|xr|sr|dr|odt|ivpb|bag|syringe|syr|lock|flush)(?:[^a-z].*)?$))'))
ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

plans.name: interchangeSql
plans.sql:
SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength,
       ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler
FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti
JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id
JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11
WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00703423901', '16729029512', '60505628201')

plans.name: stock_east activation
plans.what: What the stock_east activation reads from Corvale East's Postgres
plans.sql:
SELECT coalesce(concat('EA-', x.id), '') AS item_key, 'Corvale East' AS hospital,
       coalesce(CASE
           WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN concat('0', replace(x.raw, '-', ''))
           WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{5}-[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN concat(substr(x.raw, 1, 5), '0', substr(x.raw, 7, 3), substr(x.raw, 11, 2))
           WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{5}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1}$' THEN concat(substr(x.raw, 1, 5), substr(x.raw, 7, 4), '0', substr(x.raw, 12, 1))
           WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{11}$' THEN x.raw
           WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND x.hits = 1 THEN coalesce(x.k442, x.k532, x.k541)
           ELSE '' END, '') AS ndc11,
       x.pkg_ndc AS ndc_as_recorded, x.descr AS description,
       CAST(round(x.on_hand_pkgs * coalesce(x.pkg_size, 1), 0) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS on_hand,
       CAST(x.daily_use_pkgs * coalesce(x.pkg_size, 1) AS DECIMAL(14,3)) AS daily_use,
       coalesce(lower(trim(x.uom)), '') AS unit, CAST(coalesce(x.pkg_size, 1) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS pkg_units,
       concat('packages of ', coalesce(x.pkg_size, 1), ', converted to units') AS unit_basis,
       CASE
           WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{4,5}-[0-9]{3,4}-[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN 'dashed 10-digit, converted'
           WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{11}$' THEN '11-digit as recorded'
           WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND x.hits = 1 THEN concat('repaired: undashed, only the ', CASE WHEN x.k442 IS NOT NULL THEN '4-4-2' WHEN x.k532 IS NOT NULL THEN '5-3-2' ELSE '5-4-1' END, ' reading is in FDA')
           WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND x.hits = 0 THEN 'undashed, no reading is in FDA'
           WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' THEN concat('ambiguous: undashed, ', x.hits, ' readings are in FDA')
           WHEN x.raw = '' THEN 'blank in source'
           ELSE 'unrecognised format' END AS ndc_match
FROM (SELECT r.*, a.k AS k442, b.k AS k532, d.k AS k541,
             CASE WHEN a.k IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN b.k IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN d.k IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS hits
      FROM (SELECT e.*, trim(coalesce(e.pkg_ndc, '')) AS raw FROM corvale_east.stock_position e) r
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ndc11 AS k FROM fda.ndc_packages) a ON r.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND a.k = concat('0', r.raw)
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ndc11 AS k FROM fda.ndc_packages) b ON r.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND b.k = concat(substr(r.raw, 1, 5), '0', substr(r.raw, 6, 5))
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ndc11 AS k FROM fda.ndc_packages) d ON r.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND d.k = concat(substr(r.raw, 1, 9), '0', substr(r.raw, 10, 1))) x
